_note: Single source for every clip on the page. A clip ships only when `ready` is true AND it has either `src` (self-hosted MP4 in public/clips/, written by scripts/encode-features.sh) or `muxPlaybackId`. Both fields exist on every entry so switching hosts later is a data edit, not a rewrite. `duration` is the encoded length in seconds — it is rendered on the poster, so a visitor knows what they are committing to before they tap. Labels are the 3-part rule: format · category · result.
_resultsAreDoms: The `result` figures are Dom's own numbers. Never invent one — an unverified figure on a portfolio is a fabricated credential. Empty string = still to confirm.
